messages.name: Weyland-Yutani admin
messages.body: Our ERP retried POST /v2/payments after a timeout with the same Idempotency-Key and we got two payments.

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: That's BUG-2210-02 (High): on 2.2.1 the Idempotency-Key is ignored on POST /v2/payments only. It's fixed in 2.3.0. Delete the duplicate with DELETE /v2/payments/{payment_id}, which reopens the invoice, and check GET /v2/payments before retrying.
